text_block_list.text:
It's yakisoba dog for lunch today! ♪
Woohoo,
today's a good day! ♪
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
At Голд Шип's invitation, I join her for
lunch on
the roof of the academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whoooosh...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Well, aren't you chipper?
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text: N-Nakayama!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: A chill zips through the air like a sword!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Накаяма Феста's competitive aura
staggers
Голд Шип!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(Her vibes are really up to eleven
today... About
to pull something, is
she?!)
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Heh. When I see that fear in your eyes, it
only
makes me wanna challenge you
even more.
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text: Challenge me? To what?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
There's just a little something I wanna
try.
Sugoroku, that is.
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
Sugoroku, the traditional Japanese
board game
where players use dice to
race to the finish!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
How 'bout it? I bet you could put up a
good fight.
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
A good fight, you say? I'm not one to
pass up a
challenge...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Warning! With Голд Шипп in the zone, it's
highly
likely the match will last the
entire lunch period.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Should I send her in?! Or should I stop
her?!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, Trainer. I've got to settle this.
Go ahead
and eat lunch without me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: Wait, I'll play on your behalf.

text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, Trainer. I've got to settle this.
Go ahead
and eat lunch without me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: Wait, I'll play on your behalf.

text_block_list.text: You'll what?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Heh. Like a good challenge, do you? I'm
in!
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text: Let's do this! You versus me!
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
Oh, c'mon! Seriously? What am I,
chopped liver?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
If it's a challenge she's after, I'm going to
give
everything I've got! That was my
intent at least,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Huh. Was that it?
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
Despite my most valiant efforts, I get my
butt
handed to me on a silver platter.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, what a nice break. So how's the
game go―
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like you got owned. That's all
right
though. I'm just happy I got to
relax.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, I got this!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Heh. Then roll the dice. Whoever rolls
higher can
decide who goes first.
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text: Ding, ding, ding! And thus, their fierce battle begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hours pass, and neither side relents! The
final
stages of the game unfold, and it's
a close race to
the finish!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Rgh... This is ridiculous! No matter how
many
times I roll the dice, I can't land
right on the
finishing square!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Every time it seems Голд Шипп is about
to seize
victory, she overshoots the goal
and has to circle
back yet again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I need a four... Please! Gimme a four this
time!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Come on, then. Let's see if Lady Luck's
on your
side!
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп prays fervently, and we all
watch with
bated breath to see what she
rolls.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Clack...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: C-can it be?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
AWW YEAH! FOUR! IT'S A FOOOUR!
I'M
CLEEEAR!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hmph, looks like Lady Luck cut you a
break after
all.
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text: Ohhh yeah! How's that for lucky?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I could take on the world right now! I
could win
anything, be it a small-town
squid catching
tournament or a huge
Grand Prix race!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Well, lookie there. A six! Hahaha! Back
to the
start with ya!
text_block_list.name: Накаяма Феста

text_block_list.text: Nooo! The heck's wrong with me?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
And with that, the mighty Голд Шип
suffers
defeat...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I lost...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what's the point of living anymore...
Even
standing is such a pain...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, carry me back to the
dorm...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Victory is only for the determined and
driven. My
match with Накаяма Феста
is a painful reminder
of just how
cutthroat the world of competition
can
be.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's by the skin of her teeth, but Gold
Ship
snatches a win from the jaws of
defeat!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Burnt out, Голд Шипп loses all the wind
from her
sails...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
